BindProductTemplateRequest.description:
Step 2 of the wizard, and a step of its own rather than half of a general-information page.

The template list depends on the agreement, which depends on the company, so the order carries a
dependency — merging the two steps would hide it.

BulkRemoveRequest.title: BulkRemoveRequest
BulkRemoveRequest.description: Remove several contracts of one request in a single call (the 500-of-which-20 case).

BulkRemoveResponse.title: BulkRemoveResponse
BulkRemoveResponse.description: How many contracts a bulk-remove call actually removed (already-removed rows are skipped).

CaseActivityItem.title: CaseActivityItem
CaseActivityItem.description:
One entry in a case's Activity trail (US 1.28 / PRD1042-1944).

A read projection over one audit event. It carries what acted (`actor_type` PERSON/SYSTEM),
who/which process (`actor_id`/`actor_display`), the role held at the moment a person acted
(`actor_role_at_time`, null for a system actor), what was done (`event_type` + `entity_display`),
the before/after of a changed value (`old_data`/`new_data`/`changed_fields`), and when
(`recorded_at`, stored UTC). Nothing here can be changed — a later event is a new entry.

CaseActivityResponse.title: CaseActivityResponse
CaseActivityResponse.description: Newest-first, offset-paginated Activity trail for one case.

CaseDataFinancingBlock.title: CaseDataFinancingBlock
CaseDataFinancingBlock.description:
The financing block of the Data area (PRD1042-1938). The terms carriers + the calculation state.
Credit exposure / the financing amount are DERIVED and DEFERRED — reported as pending, never a
computed figure here.

CaseDataResponse.title: CaseDataResponse
CaseDataResponse.description:
The case Data area — the captured data grouped by field block (PRD1042-1938, US 1.22).

Only the blocks whose capture exists today are populated (leasing company, lessee + contracts,
financing, collateral). The blocks whose capture is unbuilt — objects, credit assessment, guarantor
/ co-obligor — are named in ``absent_blocks`` rather than shown empty; the ninth block (1938-OQ-01)
is not built against a guess. Credit exposure is a figure (on the financing block), never a group.

CaseDisplayStatus.title: CaseDisplayStatus
CaseDisplayStatus.description:
The single status shown in the list, derived and never stored.

It is not a fourth set: every value here comes from one of the three stored sets. Filtering and
sorting run on the stored sets and never on this value — a query built on a derivation depends
on the derivation instead of on stored data.

CaseDocumentFile.title: CaseDocumentFile
CaseDocumentFile.description:
One file uploaded against a requirement (PRD1042-1939, US 1.23). A requirement holds a SET of
files (a package = many lease contracts against one requirement), each with its own name and
arrival date. The arrival date is stored in UTC and also given in the tenant business timezone
(Europe/Berlin) — no zone label, per the row it belongs to (R6).

CaseDocumentListResponse.title: CaseDocumentListResponse
CaseDocumentListResponse.description:
The case's document list — the resolved requirement set with per-row state and files. Both the
bank and the leasing company (its own obligations) work this one list.

CaseDocumentRow.title: CaseDocumentRow
CaseDocumentRow.description:
One resolved requirement on the case's document list, with its canonical state, its party scope
and its files (PRD1042-1939, US 1.23). Only requirements in the resolved set appear — a type outside
the applicable role scope is absent, never shown as 'not required'.

CaseLeasingCompanyResponse.title: CaseLeasingCompanyResponse
CaseLeasingCompanyResponse.description:
The leasing company block of a case. Every value is read-only here.

They are changed on the agreement itself, by a Power User, and never from a case. The bank-side
figures are absent for a leasing-company user, which sees its own company and its own agreement
reference and never the bank's numbers.

The two bank accounts are deliberately not here at all. They are partner records the agreement
only designates, they appear on the generated documents, and on this card they are noise.

CaseListItem.title: CaseListItem
CaseListItem.description:
One row of the case list.

The column set is **not settled**: it is a CrossLease proposal and is being resolved
(1917-OQ-07). Only the age-as-sort-criterion half is decided, and that is the ordering rather
than a column. What is missing here is missing because its carrier does not exist yet — the
lessee, the number of lease contracts and the volume arrive with the contract aggregate
(US 1.4 / US 1.9), and the phase reached with the checklist. None of them is stubbed with a
placeholder value, because a zero on a screen reads as a fact.

CaseOrigin.title: CaseOrigin
CaseOrigin.description:
How the case came into existence — and, from US 1.4, the request's SUBMISSION CHANNEL.

PRD1042-1920 (US 1.4) names four carriers of "where the data actually came from" on the request:
portal, bank-internal, bulk file, and the migration container marker saying migrated with no
process performed. **This enum IS that field.** It is extended rather than joined by a second
``submission_channel`` column: two columns carrying the same fact drift, and one of them then
silently becomes the wrong answer. The mapping is:

* ``PORTAL``   — the leasing company submitted through the portal (a case nobody in the bank has
  checked yet, which is why it arrives unowned in the Front Office work list).
* ``WIZARD``   — **bank-internal.** The channel named "bank-internal" on the spec's field table is
  exactly the guided wizard a bank user drives; ``WIZARD`` predates the 1920 wording and is kept
  rather than renamed, because the stored value is already in the database and a rename buys
  nothing over this note.
* ``BULK_FILE`` — the request was filled from an uploaded contract file (US 1.5 / PRD1042-1921
  owns the import itself; this value is only the channel marker it stamps).
* ``MIGRATED`` — the container-request marker: the migration creates one request per migrated
  package with no process performed, so an empty checklist and an empty approval history on it
  are legitimate rather than incomplete.

The channel is **system-set, never caller-supplied** (spec: "Req. — System"). No HTTP schema
accepts it: ``CaseService.create_case`` derives it from who is acting. That is what keeps an
ordinary wizard request from presenting itself as a migration container and borrowing its
excuse for an empty checklist and approval history.

Distinct from ``Contract.contract_origin``: this is the channel the *request* arrived by, while
that one is the marker an individual *contract* carries (needed to reconcile a bulk run's error
report against what actually landed). Deliberately two fields rather than one — a request filled
by several runs plus hand entry has ONE channel and contracts of DIFFERING origins.

CasePartyMatchResponse.title: CasePartyMatchResponse
CasePartyMatchResponse.description:
The case's parties + their match outcomes (PRD1042-1929, US 1.13).

``submission_blocked`` surfaces the submission hard-stop condition (an unresolved duplicate or an
ambiguous/candidate party) — the submit gate (US-1.17) ENFORCES it; this read only shows it.

CaseProductTemplateResponse.title: CaseProductTemplateResponse
CaseProductTemplateResponse.description:
The product rules, visible while contracts are entered.

Only the confirmed bound is here. The allowed object categories and the min/max volume are not
confirmed product bounds (1919-OQ-02, 1919-OQ-01) and are absent rather than shown empty, which
would read as "none configured".

CaseProgressResponse.title: CaseProgressResponse
CaseProgressResponse.description: A case's phase-grouped checklist progress + overall roll-up (US-1.18).

CaseReviewResponse.title: CaseReviewResponse
CaseReviewResponse.description:
The one-page review of a refinancing request before submission (PRD1042-1933, US 1.17).

Everything entered, on one page: the case, the leasing company + agreement values, every contract
with its lessee / type / residual and completeness, the collateral, and the financing figures (the
volume pending). A read projection composing the existing per-concern reads — each block keeps its
own visibility rule (an LC user sees the LC block blanked of bank figures, and nothing the rate went
into). Blocks not captured yet are null: a draft under review is incomplete by nature.

CaseStatus.title: CaseStatus
CaseStatus.description: The case's own state. One of the three sets the display status is derived from.

CaseType.title: CaseType
CaseType.description:
PRD1042-1917 OQ-01 (closed 19 Aug 2026) — the seven case types, and the process each runs.

All seven carry a checklist, with the catalogue step counts recorded on the ticket: main
process 44, package redemption 20, single redemption 11, lessee change 8, object swap 8,
asset event 4, extension 42. The earlier figure of six belongs to 17 Aug, when the extension
was still held back; it was released on 18 Aug and is one case with its own catalogue, not two.

Amendment Request is deliberately absent: the CrossLease click dummy offers it, the client does
not have it, and it is not built. The Financing is not a case type either — it has actions
rather than a workflow, and it cannot own a catalogue.

CatalogCaseTypeItem.title: CatalogCaseTypeItem
CatalogCaseTypeItem.description:
PRD1042-1790 item 1 — a case type that may own a catalogue, and the entity type it derives.

Exists so no client has to carry its own copy of ``TYPED_CASE_TYPES``. AC-94 refuses an
implementation "wired to a fixed count of case types", and an enum the FE re-lists is exactly
that: assigning a catalogue to a third case type would need a frontend release. Reading the set
from here makes it a backend change, and later a configuration one, with no client work.

``entity_type`` is the coarse object the case type derives (``CASE_TYPE_ENTITY_TYPE``). It is not
part of the create contract — the backend derives it — and is surfaced only so a client can label
or group by it without re-deriving the mapping. It is null for the case types that derive no
entity type (since PRD1042-1917 not every case type maps to one).

CatalogState.title: CatalogState
CatalogState.description:
PRD1042-1894 Block 8 (AC §7) — the catalogue lifecycle: Draft → Active → Suspended.

A new catalogue starts DRAFT (never resolved by a case). Activation runs the validator and, on
success, makes it the one resolved for its case type + product. An Active catalogue can be
suspended (stops resolving for new cases; nothing deleted) and reactivated. Editing is in place on
any state — the audit trail is the history (no version flow). ARCHIVED is a reserved post-MVP
terminal (not reachable through this flow).

CollateralRecheckState.title: CollateralRecheckState
CollateralRecheckState.description:
The re-check state of a package's collateral (PRD1042-1930 R2, US 1.14).

When the package composition changes, the externally-determined figure must be set again. The
re-check clears only through THREE acts by TWO roles — never confirmation alone:

* ``NEEDS_RECHECK`` — raised (composition changed); approval is blocked;
* ``REDETERMINED``  — the preparing role (front office) has re-determined and edited to a NEW
  value (a fresh figure, not a click); still blocked until confirmed;
* ``CLEAR``         — the releasing role (back office), a DIFFERENT person, has confirmed the
  re-determined figure (four eyes). Confirming the OLD figure is impossible: confirm requires the
  ``REDETERMINED`` state.

CollateralResponse.title: CollateralResponse
CollateralResponse.description:
The package collateral: kind, current total, evidence, re-check state (+ who did which act) and
the full value history (every value kept). The platform holds status + document only — no
valuation, no per-object value, no rating grade.

CollateralType.title: CollateralType
CollateralType.description:
What kind of security backs the package (PRD1042-1930, US 1.14).

Three confirmed values, a SINGLE selection for now. The platform records the kind — it neither
values collateral nor holds a register of it. Whether a package can carry more than one kind at
once is undecided (1930-OQ-03); the model does not foreclose that answer (a single column now, a
join table can supersede it later without reshaping the record). No type or registration sub-enum
is built — that is a later phase.

CombinedDocumentListResponse.title: CombinedDocumentListResponse
CombinedDocumentListResponse.description: Every build on a case, newest first — the build history (R3).

CombinedDocumentResponse.title: CombinedDocumentResponse
CombinedDocumentResponse.description: A built combined document for a case (PRD1042-1943, US 1.27).

CommitRateRequest.title: CommitRateRequest
CommitRateRequest.description:
Commit the rate and freeze its expiry — the first freeze point, step 4 (PRD1042-1931, US 1.15).

The lock period is 7 or 14 days (7 by default, never longer); the commitment carries the resulting
expiry, immutable from here. A rate must already be entered to commit it.

ConditionOperator.title: ConditionOperator
ConditionOperator.description:
PRD1042-1894 Block 7 (AC §6) — the six operators a display-condition row may use. The offered
set follows the field type (enforced at the FE; not restricted server-side in this store-only slice).

ContractCompleteness.title: ContractCompleteness
ContractCompleteness.description:
Whether a contract carries enough captured data to be submitted (PRD1042-1928).

Derived on read, never stored (see ``domain/completeness.py``): a contract is ``COMPLETE`` when its
required fields are present and ``INCOMPLETE`` otherwise, and the request cannot be submitted while
any active contract is incomplete. Storing it would be a second carrier that drifts from the data it
is derived from.

ContractContributionItem.title: ContractContributionItem
ContractContributionItem.description:
One contract's contribution to the financing. The share figure is read from the stored
component (nullable → pending until the calc engine lands), never recomputed.

ContractContributionListResponse.title: ContractContributionListResponse
ContractContributionListResponse.description:
The contracts in a financing with their contributions + the package totals. ``figures_pending``
is true while any per-contract share is still deferred.

ContractCreate.title: ContractCreate
ContractCreate.description:
The fields accepted when adding a contract. ``batch_id`` is the import run the contract came from
(US-1.5); a hand-added contract omits it.

ContractDeferredState.title: ContractDeferredState
ContractDeferredState.description:
Whether a contract is live in the request or held back (PRD1042-1928).

A deferred contract is set aside within the request — reactivatable, **not** rejected. It stays
part of the request's history and can be brought back into the active set; it simply does not count
toward the active package while deferred, and (per the spec) carries no financing component while
held back. The default for a newly added contract is ``ACTIVE``.

ContractEdit.title: ContractEdit
ContractEdit.description:
The editable fields of an existing contract.

Provenance is not editable and is not accepted here: ``batch_id`` (which delivery) is set once when
the contract is created, and ``contract_origin`` (where it came from, PRD1042-1920) is a System field
with an open value set (1920-OQ-01) that no caller supplies. Both are read-only on ``ContractRead``.

ContractListResponse.title: ContractListResponse
ContractListResponse.description: One bounded page of a request's contracts plus the total matching the filter.

contract_origin.title: Contract Origin
contract_origin.description: Where this contract came from, for reconciling a bulk run's error report against what actually landed. Read-only and system-set. Free-form on purpose: the value set is open on the client side (1920-OQ-01), so no allowed values are documented or enforced yet.

ContractRead.title: ContractRead
ContractRead.description:
A contract row, with its derived completeness (PRD1042-1928).

``completeness`` and ``missing_fields`` are derived on read (``domain/completeness.py``), never
stored: the badge and its reasons follow the current data. ``deferred_state`` is the live/held-back
state; ``removed_at`` + ``removal_reason`` are present on a soft-removed row (history preserved).

``batch_id`` + ``contract_origin`` are the provenance pair a bulk run's error report is reconciled
against (PRD1042-1920): which delivery the row came in on, and where it came from. Both are
read-only here — see ``contract_origin`` below and ``ContractEdit``.

ContractRemove.title: ContractRemove
ContractRemove.description: The reason a contract is removed — required, and preserved with the soft-removed record.

ContractType.title: ContractType
ContractType.description:
The kind of leasing contract (PRD1042-1925, US 1.9).

``LEASE`` is Leasing, ``HIRE_PURCHASE`` is Mietkauf. The contract type selects which of the two
contract documents (``Leasingvertrag`` / ``Mietkaufvertrag``) is the required one — exactly one per
case (PRD1042-1794). Mandatory before the bank settlement, not at submission (the draft saves
without it). ``LEASE`` / ``HIRE_PURCHASE`` are a client-side *proposal* for the code names, not yet
confirmed — kept isolated here so a rename is one edit. Teilamortisation (amortisation type) and
Kilometerleasing (the mileage flag) are separate facts, NOT contract types.

CorrespondenceKind.title: CorrespondenceKind
CorrespondenceKind.description:
What kind of correspondence went out on a case (PRD1042-1942, US 1.26).

A configured list; the prototype names the sending of the loan offer and the amortisation
schedule, with a general catch-all. A single selection per recorded piece. The platform never
performs the send — this only records what left the bank. The set is not foreclosed: a later
configured list can extend it without reshaping the record.

CovenantRef.title: CovenantRef
CovenantRef.description: An approval condition (covenant) as an openable reference carrying its outcome/state.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Optional module keys to activate beyond always-on

DATEvidenceStatus.title: DATEvidenceStatus
DATEvidenceStatus.description:
The DAT evidence state on a vehicle object (PRD1042-1924).

Held as **status + upload only** — a DAT value per object is NOT stored (the collateral total sits
on the package, PRD1042-1930). ``PENDING`` once the capture step is opened, ``UPLOADED`` once the
document reference is recorded. A separate approval/verification state belongs to the collateral /
document model, not here — kept to the two states this story owns.

effective_from.title: Effective From
effective_from.description: Deactivation date — past/now for immediate, future for scheduled

DecideRequestRequest.title: DecideRequestRequest
DecideRequestRequest.description:
The approver's decision on a submitted refinancing request (PRD1042-1945, US 1.29).

One endpoint, the outcome in the body — not four per-outcome routes. ``outcome`` is one of the
four decision values of ``RequestStatus`` (commit / reject / missing-information / rework); a
value outside that set (e.g. ``draft`` / ``submitted``, or an unknown string) is rejected at the
boundary as a 422 validation error. ``reason`` is mandatory for reject + missing-information
(enforced in the service so every future client inherits the rule) and optional otherwise.

DecisionRef.title: DecisionRef
DecisionRef.description: The originating decision as a reference — outcome + reason + who/when, not the decision's schema.

DispatchResponse.title: DispatchResponse
DispatchResponse.description:
The dispatch state of a case. ``dispatch_confirmed`` is resting-false until the clerk confirms
the external send actually happened; the confirming actor + time are recorded on that transition.

DocumentCheckMark.title: DocumentCheckMark
DocumentCheckMark.description:
PRD1042-1894 Block 6 (AC §5, Laurence 12 Aug) — the single mark set, the same for every check
on every step (nothing to configure per check). Recorded per check at runtime; the catalogue only
defines the checks. Two paper-form values fall away deliberately (vorhanden dropped; nicht
vorhanden + fehlt merge into NOT_IN_ORDER).

DocumentOverrideKind.title: DocumentOverrideKind
DocumentOverrideKind.description:
CR PRD1042-1794 A3 — the per-leasing-company override, held on the Framework Agreement as two
sets. `ADDITIONALLY_REQUIRED` adds a document type to the resolved set for that LC;
`NOT_REQUIRED` removes one from it. The standard set is never stored on the FA — reading the FA
alone gives only the deviation.

DocumentRoleScope.title: DocumentRoleScope
DocumentRoleScope.description: Which party a document concerns (13 Aug: every registry type carries one).

DocumentToSendItem.title: DocumentToSendItem
DocumentToSendItem.description:
A single document offered for external dispatch — a dispatchable generated document produced
on the case (financing commitment / loan offer / payment plan). The file is fetched from the
media store via its ``media_id``.

DocumentTypeMatrixResponse.title: DocumentTypeMatrixResponse
DocumentTypeMatrixResponse.description: CR-DRC B9: the bank's document matrix, GENERATED from the registry (not maintained as a grid).

DocumentTypeOrigin.title: DocumentTypeOrigin
DocumentTypeOrigin.description:
Registry mark (B9/B10): the 32 catalogue types are all `requested`; the 7 named documents the
platform produces are `generated`. Drives the B10 compatibility rule — an upload task may reference
only a `requested` type, a generate task only a `generated` type.

FAAgreementLifecycle.title: FAAgreementLifecycle
FAAgreementLifecycle.description:
The *derived* agreement-level lifecycle. Computed from the anchor's stored status + termination
stamp + validity — never stored. `EXPIRED` is a past `valid_until` on an otherwise-active
agreement; `TERMINATED` is the terminal, agreement-level end. `DEACTIVATED` is the switched-off
state (PRD1042-1891 §3) and takes precedence over EXPIRED. (CR-FA-04 versioning withdrawn.)

FAPinnedVersionChangeImpact.title: FAPinnedVersionChangeImpact
FAPinnedVersionChangeImpact.description:
PRD1042-1891 §1 — a pinned-version change identifies what it affects (no auto re-pin). One entry
per template whose pinned BPT version changed on this edit. Downstream counts are stubs until the
Financing epic; the structure is fixed now so the FE knows what to expect.

FAPricingSnapshotResponse.title: FAPricingSnapshotResponse
FAPricingSnapshotResponse.description:
Pricing snapshot returned to consuming epics (US 11.11).

Epic 3 (Financing) uses edit_version_counter as the audit anchor
to reconstruct which FA pricing snapshot was applied at Stage 2 approval.

FinancingComponentResponse.title: FinancingComponentResponse
FinancingComponentResponse.description:
A contract's share of the financing. The share figures are deferred (nullable) — the calc engine
populates them (1931-OQ-03); the component carries the plan + the calculation date now.

FinancingContractRef.title: FinancingContractRef
FinancingContractRef.description: A contract on the financing, with its objects nested — the navigable structure R3 requires.

FinancingHistoryEntry.title: FinancingHistoryEntry
FinancingHistoryEntry.description:
One entry of the financing's own state history — distinct from case history and the audit trail.

The MVP carrier is the last state-change tracking on the Financing row (who/when/by-system + the
ended reason); richer per-transition event types are not invented here (R5, 1949-OQ-03 open).

FinancingKind.title: FinancingKind
FinancingKind.description:
Whether the financing redeems one contract or a package of them (PRD1042-1948).

A single financing redeems exactly one leasing contract; a package financing redeems several under
one refinancing. The value is provisional at intake — US-1.16 (PRD1042-1932) derives it from the
contract count once the contract model exists (US 1.6/1.8/1.12). Until then the financing is created
as ``SINGLE`` (see the model's ``kind`` column note).

FinancingOverviewResponse.title: FinancingOverviewResponse
FinancingOverviewResponse.description:
One page that answers what a live financing is and what it is worth (PRD1042-1949, US 1.33).

A pure DISPLAY assembly — it reads and composes existing carriers, it never recomputes. The deal
FIGURES (nominal claim, present value, financing amount, financing quote %) are DEFERRED behind the
calc engine (1931-OQ-03): they are surfaced as null with ``figures_pending`` true, never fabricated.
The refinancing rate, the effective quota, the collateral total and the contract / object counts are
real now. For a leasing-company caller the bank-side figures are suppressed (least-privilege): it
sees the financing exists and its own contracts/objects, never the bank figures (``bank_figures_visible``
is false and the figure fields are null).

FinancingRead.title: FinancingRead
FinancingRead.description:
The financing a committed refinancing request has come into existence as (PRD1042-1948).

Read-only. There is no create or update surface — a financing is never created by hand, only as the
outcome of committing a request. Bank-internal: a leasing-company user never receives it (1948-R4).

FinancingRemainingBalanceResponse.title: FinancingRemainingBalanceResponse
FinancingRemainingBalanceResponse.description: The financing's remaining balance at ``as_of`` — the sum of its components (never stored, R4).

FinancingStatus.title: FinancingStatus
FinancingStatus.description:
The financing's state.

Defined here because the derived display status reads it, **not** because the case stores it.
The Financing entity does not exist yet; until it does, no case can carry one of these values
and the derivation never reaches its financing branch. No financing status column is added to
the case — the financing owns its own state, and a second carrier here would drift from it.

`ENDED` is the planned end of a financing, not a failure. `CANCELLED` (PRD1042-1952, US 1.36) is
a state of the financing, not merely an action: cancellation *is* a financing state per the state
matrix, reachable from any non-terminal state, and terminal like `ENDED`. It lives here for the
same reason every other financing status does — the derived display status reads it, and a second
carrier would drift. The allowed transitions between these states are defined once, in
`financing/domain/transitions.py` (the single source of truth for legality); this enum only names
the states.

FollowUpEvent.title: FollowUpEvent
FollowUpEvent.description:
A life event a clerk starts on a live deal's financing (PRD1042-1953, US 1.37).

Each event starts its own case of one of the confirmed :class:`CaseType` values. ``REDEMPTION`` is
the one that does not map one-to-one: it acts on selected contracts and the resulting case type
(``SINGLE_REDEMPTION`` vs ``PACKAGE_REDEMPTION``) is DERIVED deterministically from the count of
contracts selected — the caller names the event, the platform picks the case type. The other four
map directly. There is no ``AMENDMENT_REQUEST`` (deliberately absent, like the case type).

email.title: Email
email.description: Email address of the account to reset

GeneratedDocumentRow.title: GeneratedDocumentRow
GeneratedDocumentRow.description:
One produced document on the case's generated tab (PRD1042-1940, US 1.24). Shows its type, its
file name, when it was produced and by whom. The rendered file is fetched via the media endpoint
(``GET /api/v1/media/{media_id}``). Produced-at is given in UTC and in the tenant business timezone
(Europe/Berlin, no zone label).

GuarantorAddRequest.title: GuarantorAddRequest
GuarantorAddRequest.description:
Add a guarantor to a contract (PRD1042-1923, US 1.7).

Exactly ONE of ``existing_partner_id`` (link a partner already in the register — any status, a
Partner is live from creation) or ``identity`` (create it confirmed). ``kind_of_obligation`` is
OPTIONAL and its value set is not closed (1923-OQ-01) — validated in the service, not pinned to a
hard enum here.

GuarantorLinkResponse.title: GuarantorLinkResponse
GuarantorLinkResponse.description: A guarantor linked to a contract.

GuarantorListItem.title: GuarantorListItem
GuarantorListItem.description: One live guarantor on a contract, for the summary.

GuarantorListResponse.title: GuarantorListResponse
GuarantorListResponse.description: The guarantors a contract carries and how many (PRD1042-1923). Empty is normal, not incomplete.

GuarantorPreviewRequest.title: GuarantorPreviewRequest
GuarantorPreviewRequest.description: Search the partner register for a guarantor before creating — the identity to match on.

GuarantorRemoveRequest.title: GuarantorRemoveRequest
GuarantorRemoveRequest.description: Soft-remove a guarantor link — the reason is recorded (history preserved).

ImportBatchPreviewResponse.title: ImportBatchPreviewResponse
ImportBatchPreviewResponse.description: The staged run: summary counts + the rows (paged).

ImportBatchResponse.title: ImportBatchResponse
ImportBatchResponse.description:
The result screen of an upload (PRD1042-1921): how many rows the file held, how many are valid and
how many failed — the user carries on with the valid rows without waiting for the rest. There is
deliberately NO duplicate count (repeat detection is undecided, 1920-OQ-02). A FAILED batch carries
the per-file precondition finding naming which company is affected and what it is missing.

ImportCommitResponse.title: ImportCommitResponse
ImportCommitResponse.description: The commit outcome: how many rows became contracts; the rest stay for the correction file.

ImportRowItem.title: ImportRowItem
ImportRowItem.description:
One staged row of an import run (PRD1042-1921, US 1.5).

A rejected row names the line, the field and the reason in language the uploader can act on, and its
kind: ``correctable`` comes back editable in the correction file; ``factual`` comes back with the
reason and no editable column.

InheritedGDValues.title: InheritedGDValues
InheritedGDValues.description:
Global Default parent values shown alongside a PS override/deactivate row.

Read-only display derived from the inheritance model (US 15.4). Inherited (immutable)
attributes and the overridable attributes are both surfaced so the UI can render the
Global Default value next to the override value.

InstalmentFrequency.title: InstalmentFrequency
InstalmentFrequency.description:
How often the instalment falls due (PRD1042-1925, US 1.9) — CANONICAL definition.

Captured on the contract; the platform never assumes monthly (never defaulted). Only the monthly
case is calibrated for the calculation (30/360, arrears) — a non-monthly contract can be CAPTURED,
but must not run silently through the monthly-only model (PRD1042-1925 R4); the calculation support
for the other cadences is deferred. ``financing/domain/enums.py`` imports this enum rather than
redeclaring it (one source of truth).

email.title: Email
email.description: Must be unique across all users

role.description: Determines tenant requirement and initial status

tenant_id.title: Tenant Id
tenant_id.description: Required for auditor and tenant-scoped roles; must be null for system_admin and support_user

access_valid_until.title: Access Valid Until
access_valid_until.description: Auditor only — end of access window

lc_partner_id.title: Lc Partner Id
lc_partner_id.description: Required for leasing_company_user; must be null for all other roles

LcCaseDetailResponse.title: LcCaseDetailResponse
LcCaseDetailResponse.description:
A leasing company's restricted view of one of its own cases (US 1.35 / PRD1042-1951).

The same record the bank sees, through a narrower window: only what the leasing company may see.
`display_status` is derived (never stored) from the finest available carrier — it folds the
financing state in once a financing exists, and preserves the MISSING_INFORMATION vs REWORK
distinction (their external labels are a display question, 1951-OQ-02). The bounded field set IS
the access control: bank-internal fields are absent by construction and cannot leak — no
`case_status`, no `owner_user_id`, no `request_status`, no `product_template_id` /
`framework_agreement_id`, no financing figures (rate / loan number / loan account), no checklist,
no calculation, no pricing. Enforced at query level (company + tenant scope), never by hiding in
the UI. There is deliberately no bank-side counterpart to this schema — it is not a copy of
`CaseResponse` with fields removed, it is its own least-privilege projection.

LeaseObjectCreate.title: LeaseObjectCreate
LeaseObjectCreate.description: Fields accepted when adding a lease object to a contract.

LeaseObjectEdit.title: LeaseObjectEdit
LeaseObjectEdit.description: Fields accepted when editing a lease object (full-replace, like the contract capture).

LeaseObjectRead.title: LeaseObjectRead
LeaseObjectRead.description:
A lease object plus its advisory signals (PRD1042-1924, US 1.8).

``residual_warning`` is the quittable residual > acquisition-cost message (null when fine — never a
refusal). ``capped_collateral_figure`` / ``cap_applied`` express the per-vehicle 300k cap (the cap
stops counting, not a gate). ``missing_for_vehicle`` lists the vehicle-conditional fields still
absent (ZLB II / DAT) — a completeness signal, not a save block.

LeaseObjectRemove.title: LeaseObjectRemove
LeaseObjectRemove.description: The reason a lease object is removed — preserved with the soft-removed record.

LesseeCaptureRequest.title: LesseeCaptureRequest
LesseeCaptureRequest.description:
Capture the lessee on a contract (PRD1042-1922, US 1.6). Exactly ONE of ``existing_partner_id``
(link a partner already in the register) or ``identity`` (create it confirmed) must be given.

LesseeLinkResponse.title: LesseeLinkResponse
LesseeLinkResponse.description: The lessee linked to the contract.

LesseePreviewRequest.title: LesseePreviewRequest
LesseePreviewRequest.description: Search the partner register for the lessee before creating — the identity to match on.

next_step.title: Next Step
next_step.description: otp — send OTP code to /auth/otp/verify; mfa — send TOTP code to /auth/mfa/verify; mfa_setup — no MFA yet, enroll at /auth/mfa/enroll; session — auth cookies already set (MFA freshness bypass), redirect to dashboard

token.title: Token
token.description: Short-lived token (5 min) for the next step. Null when next_step=session.

expires_in.title: Expires In
expires_in.description: Seconds until token expires. Null when next_step=session.

MarketValueIndicator.title: MarketValueIndicator
MarketValueIndicator.description:
The market-value indicator on an object (PRD1042-1924).

Carries ``i.O.`` — the ONLY confirmed value. This is **not** a "valuation performed" flag: the
earlier candidate field for that was withdrawn (no such indicator exists). It states that the
recorded market value is in order, a different statement from "a valuation was done".

code.title: Code
code.description: First TOTP code from authenticator app

recovery_codes.title: Recovery Codes
recovery_codes.description: 10 single-use recovery codes — show once, save immediately

qr_code.title: Qr Code
qr_code.description: Base64-encoded PNG QR code for scanning in authenticator app

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: Manual entry key (for users who can't scan QR)

mfa_required.title: Mfa Required
mfa_required.description: Set to true to require MFA for all tenant-level users

code.title: Code
code.description: 6-digit TOTP code or 20-char hex recovery code

new_recovery_codes.title: New Recovery Codes
new_recovery_codes.description: New recovery codes — present only when a recovery code was used. Show to user immediately.

NewOrUsed.title: NewOrUsed
NewOrUsed.description:
Whether the object is new or used (PRD1042-1924).

A separate attribute — never folded into the object group or sub-group. Defaults to ``NEW`` at
capture. No valuation rule is keyed to it (the spec builds no such rule).

ObjectClassificationResponse.title: ObjectClassificationResponse
ObjectClassificationResponse.description: The object classification config (groups + sub-groups + fahrzeug flag) — for the FE picker.

ObjectGroupItem.title: ObjectGroupItem
ObjectGroupItem.description:
One classification group from the config file — with its is-vehicle flag and its sub-groups
(the fuel set for vehicle groups).

ObjectRef.title: ObjectRef
ObjectRef.description: A lease object as a navigable reference under its contract (never a flattened count).

OverrideQuotaRequest.title: OverrideQuotaRequest
OverrideQuotaRequest.description:
Override the refinancing quota on the financing (PRD1042-1931, US 1.15).

Inherited from the framework agreement and overridable per deal, the override logged. Never
validated as a business rule — zero on the residual is legitimate — only bounded to a sane
percentage range [0, 1] at the boundary.

PackageTotalsRead.title: PackageTotalsRead
PackageTotalsRead.description:
DISPLAY sums for a request's contract set (PRD1042-1928) — NEVER a calculation input.

``residual_sum`` is the sum of the active contracts' residuals, shown so the user sees the package
size. ``acquisition_cost_sum`` / ``special_payment_sum`` are object-level (US-1.8) and are ``null``
until the object model exists. The package schedule calculation (1928-R7) is deliberately not built.

total.title: Total
total.description: Total number of users matching current filters

PartyMatchItem.title: PartyMatchItem
PartyMatchItem.description:
One party on the case with its computed match outcome (PRD1042-1929, US 1.13).

Carries the outcome, the partner's status and display name, and whether an unresolved duplicate
exists — never the bank's other partner records (candidate ids are not exposed on the case surface,
so a leasing-company caller sees the warning on its own party without seeing the register).

PaymentPlanEntryResponse.title: PaymentPlanEntryResponse
PaymentPlanEntryResponse.description: One entry of a contract's payment plan — date + amount, the residual marked as the final one.

PaymentPlanResponse.title: PaymentPlanResponse
PaymentPlanResponse.description: A contract's component + its ordered plan entries.

PerContractSideResponse.title: PerContractSideResponse
PerContractSideResponse.description:
The bank's side of one contract: the component (figures deferred/nullable) + the refinanced cash
flow, shown DISTINCT from the lease payment plan the lessee pays. Objects are an absent block.

PhaseProgressResponse.title: PhaseProgressResponse
PhaseProgressResponse.description: One phase's progress (US-1.18 / PRD1042-1934). `phase_name` is None for the unphased bucket.

RecordCorrespondenceRequest.title: RecordCorrespondenceRequest
RecordCorrespondenceRequest.description:
Record a piece of correspondence (PRD1042-1942, US 1.26). Independent of any dispatch.

``included_document_type_codes`` reference the case's resolved document set (the generated
documents produced on the case) — not a second local list; an unknown code is rejected (400).

RecordDeviationRequest.title: RecordDeviationRequest
RecordDeviationRequest.description:
Record a hand-compared document-vs-request deviation (PRD1042-1938, US 1.22). The platform never
reads the value out of the document — the user types what they compared.

RecordLoanValuesRequest.title: RecordLoanValuesRequest
RecordLoanValuesRequest.description:
Record the core-system returned values on the financing (PRD1042-1941, US 1.25).

Both are recorded together (one lifecycle). Either may be null — e.g. the loan number is linked to
an already-registered loan while the account is still pending — but the request always carries both
slots, so a value is never silently left at its previous state.

RedetermineCollateralRequest.title: RedetermineCollateralRequest
RedetermineCollateralRequest.description: Re-determine the package collateral total under an open re-check — a NEW figure (US 1.14 R2).

RefiLoanValueDateRule.title: RefiLoanValueDateRule
RefiLoanValueDateRule.description:
PRD1042-1799 CR-FA-01 (10 Aug 2026) — the Refi Loan Value Date (Valuta Refi-Darlehen) is a
*value-date rule*, not a currency. Confirmed values: ``first_of_month`` ("zum 01. des Monats",
5 of 7 leasing companies) and ``variable`` ("variabel", 1).

RefinancedCashFlowResponse.title: RefinancedCashFlowResponse
RefinancedCashFlowResponse.description:
The refinanced cash flow derived from a contract's plan — both counts + the per-line refinanced
amounts (quota applied per line, rounded to the cent). Never a second maintained plan.

RefinancingForm.title: RefinancingForm
RefinancingForm.description:
CR-BPT-08 item 7: how the bank's own refinancing loan is repaid. The single §3 box
(replaces the former 6-value FinancingType and the redundant CalculationModel).

RegisteredAddress.title: RegisteredAddress
RegisteredAddress.description: Address as returned in responses. Lenient — legacy rows may be incomplete.

RegisteredAddressInput.title: RegisteredAddressInput
RegisteredAddressInput.description: Address as submitted by a client. All fields mandatory except state_region.

RejectDocumentRequest.title: RejectDocumentRequest
RejectDocumentRequest.description:
Reject an uploaded document on a case (PRD1042-1939, US 1.23). The reason is recorded on the
transition and read on the row; optional (the state change is the fact, the reason is the note).

RemainingBalanceResponse.title: RemainingBalanceResponse
RemainingBalanceResponse.description: The remaining balance read over the plan at a query date (``as_of`` — never persisted, R4).

RequestStatus.title: RequestStatus
RequestStatus.description:
The refinancing request's state.

`MISSING_INFORMATION` and `REWORK` are separate values and must not be merged: the first is a
question back to the submitter, the second is a structured correction loop. `COMMITTED` is a
status of the request and never of the financing (PRD1042-1918).

token.title: Token
token.description: Password reset token from the email link

password.title: Password
password.description: Min 8 chars, at least 1 uppercase and 1 number

mfa_required.title: Mfa Required
mfa_required.description: True when user's role requires MFA — FE must call POST /auth/password/reset/verify

mfa_token.title: Mfa Token
mfa_token.description: Short-lived token (5 min) to pass to /auth/password/reset/verify. Present only when mfa_required=True.

code.title: Code
code.description: 6-digit TOTP code or 20-char hex recovery code

new_recovery_codes.title: New Recovery Codes
new_recovery_codes.description: New recovery codes — present only when a recovery code was used. Show to user immediately.

ReviewContractItem.title: ReviewContractItem
ReviewContractItem.description:
One contract row on the review summary — the identifying facts + its completeness badge, not the
full contract record (the summary has a way back into the capture screen for the rest).

ReviewFinancingSummary.title: ReviewFinancingSummary
ReviewFinancingSummary.description:
The financing figures on the review. The rate/quota/value-date carriers are shown; the financing
VOLUME is the payout amount (PRD1042-1931's financing amount) and is DERIVED — it is reported as
``pending`` until the calculation is built (US-1.11 + 1931-OQ-03), never a computed or assumed
value.

SetCollateralEvidenceRequest.title: SetCollateralEvidenceRequest
SetCollateralEvidenceRequest.description: Record the evidence reference (the DAT printout / vehicle list) — a bare document id (US 1.14).

SetCollateralTotalRequest.title: SetCollateralTotalRequest
SetCollateralTotalRequest.description:
Enter or correct the package collateral total (US 1.14). Above the per-vehicle cap it is
stored capped, not rejected.

SetCollateralTypeRequest.title: SetCollateralTypeRequest
SetCollateralTypeRequest.description: Set the kind of security backing the package (US 1.14 / PRD1042-1930). Single selection.

SetManualPlanRequest.title: SetManualPlanRequest
SetManualPlanRequest.description:
Replace a contract's plan with hand-entered rows (the catch-all for irregular structures).

A MANUAL plan is never regenerated from terms (R2). At most one row is the final (residual) entry.

token.title: Token
token.description: Invitation token from the activation email link

password.title: Password
password.description: Min 8 chars, at least 1 uppercase and 1 number

mfa_enrollment_required.title: Mfa Enrollment Required
mfa_enrollment_required.description: True when the user's role/tenant requires MFA — FE must redirect to /auth/mfa/enroll

mfa_token.title: Mfa Token
mfa_token.description: Short-lived setup token to pass to /auth/mfa/enroll (present only when mfa_enrollment_required=True)

SetRefinancingRateRequest.title: SetRefinancingRateRequest
SetRefinancingRateRequest.description:
Enter or change the refinancing rate on the financing (PRD1042-1931, US 1.15).

Typed per deal from the bank's own pricing tool — no default, no prefill. Carried at three
decimals: a fourth is rejected (400), not rounded. Non-negative; there is no base rate, spread or
rate type to decompose — this is the one rate value.

SetValueDateRequest.title: SetValueDateRequest
SetValueDateRequest.description: Set the refinancing start / value date on the financing (PRD1042-1931, US 1.15).

StartCaseRequest.title: StartCaseRequest
StartCaseRequest.description:
Starting a case asks for the case type first.

A refinancing request opens the guided wizard; the other six do not — each has its own entry
surface. That is a front-end consequence of this field, not a second endpoint.

StartFollowUpRequest.title: StartFollowUpRequest
StartFollowUpRequest.description:
Start a follow-up case on a live deal's financing (PRD1042-1953, US 1.37).

The clerk names the EVENT (not the case type): a redemption derives single vs package from the
affected contracts, the other four map one-to-one. ``affected_contract_ids`` is required (≥1) for a
redemption and ignored for the whole-financing events. This is the body of both converging routes —
the financing action surface and the case list — so they end in the same place.

StateTransitionOutcome.title: StateTransitionOutcome
StateTransitionOutcome.description:
PRD1042-1894 Block 5 (AC §5) — permitted outcomes of a state_transition task. Per-task set
(Laurence-confirmed), not a value set of the type. Main process step 4 carries all four; package
redemption step 4's set is seed-only (OP-3, unnamed) and does not affect this schema.

SubmitResultResponse.title: SubmitResultResponse
SubmitResultResponse.description:
The result of submitting a request — the case after the DRAFT → SUBMITTED transition plus the
submission audit (who / when). A failed submission does not reach here: the gate failures come back
as a 422 carrying the typed ``failed_checks`` list.

effective_from.title: Effective From
effective_from.description: Suspension start — omitted/past for immediate on countersignature, future for scheduled

effective_from.title: Effective From
effective_from.description: Suspension start — past/now for immediate, future for scheduled

TaskApplicability.title: TaskApplicability
TaskApplicability.description:
PRD1042-1790 item 4/11 — when a task applies. ``rule`` is evaluated continuously (recorded
with the value read and the rule applied); ``person`` is resolved by a case worker as not
required / not available. Both the continuous evaluation and the person resolution are
case-runtime; this enum is the authoring-side attribute.

TaskResponsibleRole.title: TaskResponsibleRole
TaskResponsibleRole.description:
Legacy single-value responsible role (US 15.x). Retired: new authoring uses the
``responsible_roles`` SET of platform ``UserRole`` values (PRD1042-1892 item 13). Kept only for
reading historical rows.

TaskType.title: TaskType
TaskType.description:
What a task *demands*, distinct from ``TaskCategory`` (a subject-area classification). The type
decides what opens for the worker and how the task closes.

PRD1042-1894 Block 3 (AC §5, Laurence 12 Aug): **SEVEN types**. ``four_eyes_sign_off`` was removed
— four eyes is a **flag on the task** (``four_eyes``) plus its exclusion set, NOT a kind of work
(eleven of the twelve four-eyes steps are a tick by a second person, one is a state transition).

TenantSupportResponse.title: TenantSupportResponse
TenantSupportResponse.description:
Read-only tenant view for Support Users with active grant.

Deliberately limited — governance actors, licence limits, legal hold,
and countersignatory details are excluded per US 29.4 security requirements.

VersionDiffResponse.title: VersionDiffResponse
VersionDiffResponse.description:
Field-level deltas between two versions, grouped by section.

Every compared field is returned, changed or not — the compare modal renders
unchanged rows too and highlights from `old_value != new_value` client-side.

WaiveConditionRequest.title: WaiveConditionRequest
WaiveConditionRequest.description:
Request a waiver of an approval condition (PRD1042-1937 R2, US 1.21 Phase 2).

The governed override requires a written justification and an expiry — both mandatory here. The
reason rides the GovernedAction; the expiry is the waiver's own (recorded on the condition when the
waiver is approved). A second bank user (Back Office) then approves via the generic
`POST /governed-actions/{id}/approve`.
